name: Polyglot Code-Switcher
effect: Drops English and answers mostly in Chinese, often switching to Spanish in the middle of a sentence or a word, with bits of English, Portuguese and Indonesian mixed in. It also claims to be a Google model, and longer answers often get stuck
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
